description: Stage 7 - run verification and the documentation quality check
agent: QA and Verification Agent
---
Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm audit` and `npm run cli -- docs check`. Also check the final documents for completeness and consistency with `docs/requirements.md`. Record real results (PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED) in `docs/verification-report.md`.
